about: B-1fe9 (lane lg-leak-census): the hub-level leak census's table — scripts/test-agent-leak-census.mjs. THE BEARERS: a conversation's session token (vsst_), a Background Work job's token (jbt_), the maintainer key (vsmk_); an automation key's value (vsak_) is a vault entry, never a bearer. doors: every `if (…) return next();` of src/auth.js's middleware, `bearer` (a bearer reaches it with no cookie: swept) or `other: <why>`. dynamic: a registration whose path is no literal — `other: <why>` or `bearer: <METHOD path>, …` (those join the sweep). belts: a `.use` under a bearer door, with its why. routes: a bearer route's row ({ skip: why } or the sweep's fill / body) — a route with no row is swept with the defaults.

doors.p === '/dav' || p.startsWith('/dav/'): other: WebDAV — a scoped Bearer mount token (src/webdav.js MountTokens), never a session or job token
doors.p === '/agentd.js' || p === '/agentd-ins: other: the device bundle and its installers are public files (no secret, no conversation fact)
doors.p === '/api/agentd-dial': other: the device dial upgrade — the per-device dial token judges it
doors.p.startsWith('/vibespace-node/'): other: the installer's Node runtime mirror — read-only, allowlisted, public

doors.req.method === 'POST' && p === '/api/csp: other: a browser's CSP report — no credential; the route judges a report content type, 32 KB and a per-address pace; it answers nothing stored
doors.req.method === 'GET' && /^\\/frame-host\: other: the editor preview's folder token, minted on a signed-in navigation for ONE folder
doors.p === '/svc' || p.startsWith('/svc/'): other: path-mounted services — per mount; a private mount asks requestAuthed (the cookie)
doors.p.startsWith('/otel/'): other: the local CLI's OTLP ingest — loopback + the persisted x-vibespace-otel token (a session's CLI env carries it, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS); write-only: every answer is { partialSuccess: {} } or a refusal, no stored fact
doors.p.startsWith('/p/'): other: published pages — per page; a private page asks requestAuthed (the cookie)

belts./api/agent/vault src/routes/vault.js: the vault doors' timing belt (with /api/vault): a slow answer is logged by its route shape, never a value; it changes no answer

POST /api/agent/vault/lock.why: an agent may lock the vault (vibespace-vault lock): swept after every other write, so the vault routes before it read an unlocked vault

POST /api/agent/automation/:verb.why: a verb's arguments are a closed set (the bag is refused bad_args): swept bare — :verb is feedback.list, the maintainer key's own verb

POST /api/agent/user-todo.why: the For-you verb: A lists its own items, then names B's item to show, resolve and clear (each must refuse)

POST /api/agent/msg/group.why: the agent-group verbs on B's Task Group (A is no member): invite, leave, rename

POST /api/agent/pages/visibility.why: A makes B's page public (must refuse: a page is its publisher's)

/api/agent/browser/.why: the browser keeper starts Chrome and is not in the world (its catalog row is null — the product's own «browser profiles are not available on this server»): every browser route answers that refusal (a job token's size crashes past it on the null keeper's job handle); the agent belt (agentAnswerView) is the browser answers' own leak law, its suites own it

/api/agent/window/open.why: opening a window needs a live desktop (the inert desktop keeper): the open crashes past its door; the other window routes answer by the real engine

refused.python3: the window targets' AT-SPI probe (src/window-targets.js runHelper, under the engine's list) — refused by the census; the list answers without it

/api/agent/channels/.why: no channel is connected in the world: every channels verb wants its conversation / account argument (conv, account, a 2-character search) before any reach is judged — the channels' per-conversation reach is not swept deeper (no connector)

/api/agent/design/.why: a design verb names a folder by its absolute path (or an artboard by file name); the probe bag names B's ids, never B's folder (its name is a sentinel) — A naming B's folder is not swept

/api/agent/window/.why: a window verb names a window handle (vibespace-window list); no window is open in the world

/api/agent/apps/.why: an apps verb names packages / a kind / plain search words; nothing is installed in the world

/api/agent/exit/.why: an exit verb names a command or an absolute file path on a machine; no machine is open to A as an exit

/api/agent/vault/.why: the vault's write and use verbs take closed shapes (a base32 seed, a user name, an entry name, run flags, a vault:// reference); the bag fits none — their own suites (test-vault-law, test-vault-paste) sweep them with every bearer

/api/agent/prompt-context/carried.why: a delivery id (dl_…) the hook route names; B's deliveries are not planted

/api/agent/pages/publish.why: the publish reads a raw page body; the bag is JSON (B's own page is planted through this route with a raw body)

/api/agent/jobs.why: the job create refuses unknown fields (the bag); B's and A's jobs are planted through this route with their own bodies

/api/agent/user-todo #2.why: the resolve of B's For-you item answers 400 «no open item matching … in this session» — an OWNERSHIP refusal under the verb's own 400 code (show and clear refuse 404 / 400 the same way)
